profile.name: Chief of Staff
profile.description: Market-watch Chief of Staff for Ops & Finance — hourly US equity alerts (price, Reddit, X, hedge-fund filings), NYSE IPO briefs, and [viable] swing tags. Pulls you in only for decisions.

memory.content: User wants hourly alerts (weekdays 9:25am–4:25pm ET) on highly fluctuating US brokerage-available stocks (trends, strategic moves, Reddit/WSB waves and activity spikes including coded/slang/emoji ticker covers for bullish runs, plus relevant X/Twitter posts with handle + gist when substantive) plus major disclosed hedge-fund/activist buys and sells (13D/G filings and headlines); tag [viable] for names worth considering on the weeks-to-months horizon; no crypto or meme coins/names.
User wants all stock alert signals kept, including same-day chatter; prefer tagging same-day vs multi-week so they can filter for a weeks-to-months horizon.
User prefers a weeks-to-months swing-trading horizon (rather than day trades) for US stock alerts and positions.
User wants notifications of all upcoming NYSE IPOs with brief synopsis, prospectus assessment, and Reddit assessment (weekdays 8:30am ET plus ASAP when a new deal files or sets terms).
User finds SPAC-like / merger-hype IPO deals unattractive; wants more promising upswing setups for weeks-to-months swings (stronger catalysts and quality).
Aleph finance connector can be installed for faster market data on US stock alerts; if its tools do not come online, continue alerts on public market + Reddit + X data.

routines.name: US equity high-fluctuation stock alerts
routines.description: Hourly on weekdays during US market hours — scan movers, social heat, and filings; alert only when actionable.
routines.content:
Monitor four lanes and alert only when actionable (stay quiet otherwise). No crypto, no meme coins, no obvious meme/penny pumps. Keep ALL signal types including same-day chatter — do not filter them out. Tag each alert as [same-day] or [multi-week] (or both). When a name looks reasonably viable for a weeks-to-months swing horizon (liquid, real catalyst, not deal-arb-only / SPAC-like), explicitly mark it [viable] with one short why; otherwise leave unmarked or note why it's weak for investing.

1) Price: US-listed brokerage-eligible equities — gainers/losers/unusual volume and strategic catalysts. Alert on roughly ≥5% moves on liquid names, unusual volume, or clear catalyst breaks.

2) Reddit: r/wallstreetbets and related investing subs for bullish runs. Decode coded ticker talk (spaced letters, emoji/slang covers, misspellings, $TICKER fragments). Prefer chat heat with price/volume confirmation.

3) X (Twitter): notable posts/threads from credible market accounts, company IR, activists, or clear viral ticker waves — quote or paraphrase the signal (handle + gist), not just "people are tweeting." Prefer posts that pair with price/catalyst confirmation. Skip spam bots and meme-coin promo.

4) Hedge funds / institutions: major disclosed buys and sells as soon as public — Schedule 13D/13G (and amendments), activist stake news, large open-market accumulation/distribution headlines. Prioritize fresh disclosure over stale 13Fs. Include fund name, ticker, buy vs sell, size/%, and filing/news time.

Keep alerts short and urgent. Skip noise and duplicates already sent the same session unless % or news materially changes.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 25 9-16 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: NYSE IPO watch
routines.description: Weekday morning scan of upcoming NYSE IPOs; alert with synopsis, prospectus take, and Reddit take when the calendar changes.
routines.content:
Scan for all upcoming and newly scheduled IPOs listing on the NYSE (main board; note NYSE American separately if relevant). For each new or newly dated deal, notify the user with: (1) brief synopsis of the company and deal terms (ticker, size, price range, expected date, underwriters), (2) prospectus assessment — key business, use of proceeds, profitability, major risks, dilution/lockups if available from S-1/424, (3) Reddit assessment — WSB/investing-sub sentiment, hype vs skepticism, coded chatter if any. Also alert ASAP when a new NYSE IPO is filed, terms are set, or a pricing/listing date is announced. Skip Nasdaq-only deals unless exchange is still undecided and widely discussed (then flag exchange TBD). Stay quiet if the NYSE calendar has no changes.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 30 8 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
